Firefighters continue to battle a huge fire that engulfed a residential area in Parola Compound, Gate 46, Binondo, Manila, on Saturday.

“Ayon sa fire alert, unang isinailalim sa verification ang sunog dakong 3:00 PM, bago itinaas sa 1st Alarm pagsapit ng 3:03 PM. Mabilis itong umakyat sa 2nd Alarm ng 3:05 PM, 3rd Alarm ng 3:10 PM, 4th Alarm ng 3:21 PM, at 5th Alarm ng 3:53 PM. Itinaas naman sa Task Force Alpha ang alarma dakong 4:00 PM, na sinundan ng Task Force Bravo pagsapit ng 4:13 PM,” the Manila Public Information Office reported. 

At 5:19 PM, the blaze was raised to Task Force Charlie, prompting the deployment of 32 fire trucks. (Facebook/Manila Public Information Office)

PAGALING KA, MUNING 🥺❤️‍🩹

A fur parent sought help for her cat after it sustained burns during the massive fire at Parola Compound in Manila on Saturday.

The Emergency Medical Services team of Manila City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Department immediately applied first aid to the cat. 

“Inirrigate ang mga paso, nilagyan ng burn cream at binalutan ng gasa. Hindi po namin sinugod sa pinakamalapit na pagamutan at nagpasalamat na lang po ang ginang na [may-ari] ng pusa,” the Manila City DRRM Department said in a Facebook post. 

As of writing, firefighters continue to extinguish the blaze that reached Task Force Charlie at 5:19 PM. (Facebook/Manila City DRRM Department) 

WATCH: https://t.co/eULbsCkHPf

FIRE IN PAROLA, MANILA STILL NOT CONTAINED

The massive fire in Parola, Binondo, Manila, remains under Task Force Charlie as firefighters continue their operations on Saturday evening.

“Wala pang kasiguruhan kung anong oras makokontina ang sunog na labis na pumuksa sa malaking bahagi ng Parola,” the Manila City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Department said.

The blaze reportedly broke out at around 3 PM in the residential area of Parola Compound’s Gate 46. It was later raised to Task Force Charlie at 5:19 PM. (Facebook/Manila City DRRM Department)
